title: Bias-Adjusted LLM Agents for Human-Like Decision-Making via Behavioral Economics

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating the one-shot ultimatum game with LLM agents conditioned on individual-level behavioral economic traits (e.g., reciprocity, risk aversion, inequality aversion) and comparing the resulting decision-making distributions (offer amounts and acceptance rates) to empirical human data using Wasserstein distances.
